definitions.explanation: A physical sensation, especially of comfort or discomfort.
One's underlying sentiment or the feeling behind an action.

examples.japanese: あなたの{気持|きも}ちは{分|わ}かります。
このソファは{気持|きも}ちがいい。
examples.notes: {気持|きも}ちがいい = feels good

examples.japanese: {気持|きも}ちを{伝|つた}えたい。
examples.english: I want to convey my feelings.

notes:
Very common word covering emotions, physical sensations, and intentions.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{気持|きも}ちがいい (feels good, comfortable)
・{気持|きも}ちが{悪|わる}い (feels bad, uncomfortable, creepy)
・{気持|きも}ちを{伝|つた}える (convey one's feelings)
・{気持|きも}ちが{分|わ}かる (understand someone's feelings)
・お{気持|きも}ちだけで (just the thought [is enough])

RELATED WORDS:
・{気分|きぶん} - mood, feeling (more about general state)
・{感情|かんじょう} - emotion (more formal/psychological)
・{心|こころ} - heart, mind (deeper)
